steps.content: Max King has expected some troublemakers at his campaign rally, but not this many.

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: You've talked a lot about your dreams and visions. How about shedding some light on that lawsuit?

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: Word is the lawsuit was suddenly dropped. Have you struck a deal with someone in power? Is this what your self-proclaimed "man of integrity" resorts to?

Accusations and disruptions saturate the air from every angle—they are here to disgrace him. Yet, Max King welcomes their presence; these are precisely the voices he seeks. He appreciates that his adversary took the bait. Now, it's his move.
He raises the microphone with determination.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Excellent question. No, I didn't make any deals. I fell flat on my face and paid the price for my naivete. However, it was a valuable lesson learned.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: No, no, no, I can't just take! Shifu says we're not supposed to accept food from villagers without earning it...

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Corporations, dynasties, oligarchs, media outlets, and bureaucracies—they have the ability to strip me of wealth, silence my voice, and manipulate even my closest allies to intimidate me. At this moment, I do stand defenseless against them.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: In this sacred election that will determine the city's future, there's still such a group who can easily twist any citizen's will to their whim, even expecting my compliance as if it were their natural right.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I say—to hell with them!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I owe "thanks" to Cavendish and the puppet masters pulling her strings. It is through them that I gain a clear sight of the true malice corroding our city.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: For nearly a century, the parasites in our city have grown ever more. They have fostered a will of their own—bloated, rotten, resistant to progress and change—becoming a tumor that drains our city.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I'm glad they're trying to crush me by any means necessary, forcing me to bow my head. But it only proves one thing—we can hurt them, and we can defeat them! With your support, together we can liberate DisCity from their control!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Today, I stand here, not for power, but for change; not for myself, but for "us." I will be the voice that speaks for the common folk, for Syndicate, and for everyone who yearns for change to DisCity!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: This is a great city we have. Don't let it fall ill. Let's heal it! Let's work together to make it stand tall once again!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Let me fight for you! Fight for a brighter tomorrow!
The hall falls silent for a moment, only to erupt into feverish cheers as expected—but there's a discordant shrillness to the applause.

steps.speaker: Overexcited Spectator
steps.content: Holy ****, he's going all out! Gotta stream it! This is gonna be the hottest headline!

steps.speaker: Overexcited Spectator
steps.content: M-K! M-K! M-K!!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Dang, he's on fire! Even after all the drama he's been through, he's still able to charm the crowd with just a few words.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...Calm down. What else could those words be for other than manipulating the masses? He's either a clueless airhead or a sly crook saying that, but one thing never changes—he's a total megalomaniac.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: The pampered little prince has coasted through life on easy street. So easy that he actually believes swagger alone can solve everything. Almost makes me feel sorry for him.
The audience continues to roar with excitement, their voices filling the hall—but upon closer listening, one will realize they're not actually cheering for MK as their ideal future leader.

Amidst the wild shouts and cheers, people throw out questions they don't truly care about, jostling over the microphone simply to vent their excitement. A frail, disheveled man barely manages to lay his hand on the mic, only to be almost shoved to the ground.

steps.speaker: Disheveled Man
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>...You said you'll speak for us—</size></color>

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Sorry? Sir, could you repeat?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Hey, team! That man over there, in the cloak, he's got something to say! Please get him a mic. I want to hear his voice!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: You've come all the way from the West District to attend my rally. You must have a lot to share. Please, go ahead!
The man gets back to his feet and takes hold of the microphone.

steps.speaker: Disheveled Man
steps.content: You come from money, no? Never had to run with gangs, never saw the Rustfire.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Thank you for your question, sir.
Adrian is the first to notice the situation taking a dangerous turn and promptly signals the control room to cut the microphone. However, the operator in charge holds a different opinion.
The young operator seems to perceive this as a perfect opportunity to showcase MK's influence in the West District. And so the speech continues for another half minute.

steps.speaker: Disheveled Man
steps.content: The West District was attacked again just last month. You say you care about us... but did you even ask about it? Did you look into it?

steps.speaker: Disheveled Man
steps.content: Your old dog was quite active during his time in Syndicate. Do you even know what he did?

steps.speaker: Disheveled Man
steps.content: You, Cavendish, Stewart—you're all the same.

steps.speaker: Disheveled Man
steps.content: You ain't speaking for us, you speak for YOU. So cut your fancy words.
Max King had never pondered these questions, or he would have formulated an appropriate response instead of just freezing up. Yet, the stage he's standing on right now allows no room for reflection.
As the crowd grows rowdy once more, MK's opponents, who had infiltrated the venue, seize upon his moment of weakness. They raise their voices of taunt, adding fuel to the fire.

steps.speaker: Agitator
steps.content: Quiet now, huh? With all that big talk, you just take Syndicans as a bunch of fools easy to control, don't you? You say Cavendish has a puppet master, so who's pulling your strings? The Outlands?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: No! I—
But are his explanations really wanted? In the shadows, multiple gun barrels ominously rise.
With the instinct of a seasoned soldier, Adrian swiftly detects the impending danger. He makes the decisive call—instead of pursuing the gunmen, he lunges to shield the person he's sworn to protect.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Get down—!!
